scope: deterministic reference-adapter orchestration regression; shared physical models, no telemetry or flight validation

independent_accounting.note: closed-form arithmetic applies only to this no-generation, zero-other-load, unit-efficiency fixture

limits: execute ended planned services except explicit skips, then return to the declared terminal attitude at each cycle boundary
execution replay must be supported; terminal-return policy can differ from the original uninterrupted plan
energy losses are declared external state disturbances; their physical cause is not simulated
all non-ready revisions stop the scenario; a failed update never becomes the accepted plan
expected failure can pass a scenario assertion while operations remain stopped for review
shared feasibility models test orchestration consistency, not independent spacecraft physics
rejections describe evaluated starts in their trial timeline, not continuous infeasibility
neighboring activities are context; removing one is not proven sufficient to make a placement feasible
first failing checks are reported; later checks may not have been evaluated
a trial limit or exhausted neighborhood is not a global optimality proof
